rules: No new label datasets; CSV exclusions are not called not_recorded.
No raw native thread exports, unrelated system processes, private infrastructure registries or global workspace indices in the public candidate.
Generated duplicate/synthetic containers, pyc, environment trees and duplicate archives are excluded explicitly; this is not a full environment snapshot.
Private exact exclusion paths remain in the local audit map, not this public view.
Some files read during early local packaging attempts were later excluded from publication; private original bytes and failure records remain.
